ranked.headline: Fused molecular and protein encoders drive drug-target and drug-disease prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein and chemical encoders are being fused with attention and contrastive objectives across drug-target, synergy, and repositioning tasks.

ranked.headline: Auxiliary controls and structural priors constrain biomedical image representations
ranked.summary: Robustness to cohort, slide, and species shifts is becoming central as biomedical imaging models move across sites and domains.

ranked.headline: Inferring dynamical parameters and path-space divergences from single-cell trajectories
ranked.summary: Recent work infers path-space divergences and gene-regulatory parameters directly from time-resolved single-cell trajectory data, not summary statistics.

ranked.headline: Generative models encode synthetic feasibility within molecular design objectives
ranked.summary: Five 2026 publications extend generative and docking methods with predictive objectives, including synthesizability-rewarded antibiotic design.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics ties repeat expansion and gene loss to lineage-specific evolution
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale assemblies across Cathaya, grapevine, notothenioids, Lupinus and duckweeds enable direct cross-lineage tests of genome architecture.

ranked.headline: Graph and contrastive deep learning integrate spatial and single-cell multi-omics data
ranked.summary: Learned fusion of heterogeneous omics and imaging modalities now pairs interpretability with cross-modal inference across spatial and single-cell platforms.

ranked.headline: Software tools target simulation, alignment bias, and reproducibility in genomics
ranked.summary: Tools for simulated benchmarking, cross-species alignment filtering, and score validation address reproducibility and bias in genomic analyses.

ranked.headline: Explicit structure imposed on high-dimensional omics to recover spatial organization
ranked.summary: Recent preprints impose explicit tensor and topological structure on high-dimensional omics data, with spatial heterogeneity now a direct analytical target.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned generative models design protein, RNA, and regulatory DNA sequences
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair structural or energetic representations with generative models to design coding and regulatory sequences.

ranked.headline: Evaluating predicted and designed structures for geometry, interfaces, and energy
ranked.summary: Current structure predictors and design-derived energy functions are being tested against motif geometry, peptide and antibody interfaces, and RNA assemblies.

ranked.headline: Evaluating AI models that predict cellular responses to genetic and drug perturbations
ranked.summary: Current virtual cell benchmarks are being questioned for scientific value, prompting stricter baselines and evaluation alongside new models.

ranked.headline: Statistical models of spatial structure and multi-omic networks in disease profiling
ranked.summary: Visium HD resolution and 190-dataset spatial benchmarks push omics analysis toward explicit statistical models of spatial dependence and multi-omic structure.

ranked.headline: Genomic context shapes regulatory activity, from chromosomal position to cell-type eQTLs
ranked.summary: Single-cell chromatin profiling, genome-scale interaction maps, and eQTL fine-mapping now resolve regulatory effects by cell type and genomic setting.

ranked.headline: Genomic and metagenomic inference links microbial traits to host and disease outcomes
ranked.summary: Genome-scale and metagenomic inference now addresses pathogen population structure, microbiome colonization, and host-linked virulence.

ranked.headline: Automated, reproducible software packaging of established omics analysis steps
ranked.summary: Recent tools package bulk RNA-seq, proteomics, and single-cell steps into reproducible software with defined interfaces and benchmarked performance.

ranked.headline: Computational methods refine transcript and protein quantification from RNA data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark imputation methods and resolve isoform and transcript-start diversity in single-cell and long-read RNA data.

ranked.headline: Spatial models link viral dispersal to host interferon responses during infection
ranked.summary: Respiratory and influenza studies now model viral dispersal across spatial scales, connecting spread within tissue to interferon responses.

ranked.headline: Pangenome and haplotype-aware assemblies expose variation missed by linear references
ranked.summary: T2T and haplotype-resolved assemblies now document structural variation that linear-reference analyses miss.

ranked.headline: Physics-based sampling and scoring advance docking, free energy and coarse-grained models
ranked.summary: Recent releases refine physics-based docking, benchmark free energy methods, and extend coarse-grained force fields to larger complexes.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking ancestry and imputation methods across ancient and modern human genomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark local ancestry and ancient DNA imputation tools while linking HLA structural haplotypes to expression differences.

ranked.headline: Parameterized models link cell-scale forces and order to tissue-scale behavior
ranked.summary: Recent models isolate specific mechanical terms and test them against collective migration, order measures, and organelle-driven jamming.

ranked.headline: Computational reuse of multi-omic and structural data to prioritize cancer targets
ranked.summary: Public cancer multi-omic resources and structural features are now being scored computationally to nominate targets, biomarkers, and combination therapies.

ranked.headline: Software tools for bacterial recombination, community design and taxonomic profiling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce scalable, standardized computational tools for microbial genomics, community design, and profiler benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Large-scale mining of public sequence data expands viral and phage genomic diversity
ranked.summary: Petabase-scale and metagenomic mining now yield novel viral diversity, with new annotation-free scoring and long-read tools.

ranked.headline: Structural models reclassify USH2A missense variants and inform exon-skipping design
ranked.summary: Structure-derived features now supply constraints for variant pathogenicity and exon-skipping target selection beyond sequence conservation.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and structure prediction guide receptor ligand and response design
ranked.summary: Structure prediction and protein language models now prioritize receptor ligands and predict cellular responses to receptor variants before testing.

ranked.headline: Transformer models advance taxonomy, genomic foundation modeling, and proteomics
ranked.summary: New transformer and variational autoencoder tools report gains over existing classifiers, rescoring methods, and binning approaches.

ranked.headline: Computational methods for immune receptor pairing and tumor-reactive T cell detection
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial platforms now resolve receptor pairing, tumor-reactive T cells, and multi-study tissue atlases at cellular resolution.

ranked.headline: Noise and spatial regulation shape emergent network and multicellular organization
ranked.summary: Simulation and language-model analyses now test how regulatory noise, spatial rules and protein attention encode dynamical organization.

ranked.headline: Geometric encodings and deterministic sampling speed RNA structure search and folding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report faster RNA 3D structure search, deterministic cotranscriptional folding enumeration, and motif-based enzyme function annotation.

ranked.headline: State-resolved conformational ensembles link protein dynamics to function
ranked.summary: Atomistic simulation and energetic analysis are mapping conformational ensembles that connect protein dynamics to biological function.

ranked.headline: Constrained generative models map whole-brain dynamics from EEG, MEG and fMRI
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair learned dynamical, language-model and cortical-geometry priors with noninvasive neural recordings to improve brain-state inference.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict immune recognition from TCR, epitope, and viral escape data
ranked.summary: New preprints and a published B-cell epitope predictor pair structure and language-model features with immune recognition tasks.

ranked.headline: Constrained models link metabolic feasibility and growth costs to community outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent work computes growth costs of suboptimal protein allocation and cross-feeding effects on microbial diversity from constrained models.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking automated annotation against explicit reference standards
ranked.summary: Evolving ground truth and expanding gene prediction beyond mammals make continuous, reproducible benchmarking of annotation methods necessary.

ranked.headline: Molecular dynamics resolves ion permeation and blocker binding in membrane channels
ranked.summary: Recent simulations separate TRPV5 Ca2+ from Na+ selectivity and distinct Kv2 blocker modes, alongside ceramide effects on VDAC-HKI assembly.

ranked.headline: Modular recurrent architectures pair tractable analysis with flexible dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study converge on modular and linearized descriptions of recurrent networks, including molecular implementations.

ranked.headline: Inference tools denoise, deconvolve and annotate single-cell and spatial transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell transcriptomic data demand tools that correct technical noise, cell-type mixing and doublets before biological interpretation.
